title: AI Cloud Firm Nscale Seeks $3.5 Billion in Pre-IPO Financing
description: Nscale, a cloud computing firm focused on artificial intelligence, is in talks with potential investors to raise as much as $3.5 billion in financing ahead of a planned initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Ayako Yoshioka Discusses Tech’s Impact on Inflation and Prices
description: Ayako Yoshioka, a Senior Investment Strategist at Wealth Enhancement Group, joins the show to discuss technology’s role in the inflation outlook. The segment frames a client conversation around whether technology could help stoke inflation in the near term or, alternatively, contribute to lower prices and cost relief for the broader economy over time. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strong Jobs Report Revives Fed Rate-Hike Bets
description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Senior Research Analyst Julie Biel, KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk, Jefferies Tech Sector Leader, Software/Internet Research Brent Thill, Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhury, Wealth Enhancement Group Senior Investment Strategist Ayako Yoshioka, The Points Guy Senior Newsletter Editor Becky Blaine, & SUNY Purchase President Michael Steiper. (Source: Bloomberg)
